about.title: About Panorama Seaside
about.subtitle: Your Home by the Sea
about.description: Located in the picturesque fishing village of Mastichari on the western coast of Kos Island, Panorama Seaside Studios is a family-run complex just steps from the golden sandy beach. Our 9 comfortable studios and apartments offer the perfect base for an authentic Greek island holiday, with the gentle sound of waves and stunning Aegean sunsets right from your balcony.
about.feature1Desc: Just steps from Mastichari's golden sandy beach, with direct access to the crystal-clear Aegean waters.
about.feature2Desc: Genuine Greek warmth from our family to yours — personalized service that makes every guest feel at home.
about.feature3Desc: Clean, well-equipped studios with everything you need — kitchenette, air conditioning, and private balcony.
about.story: Panorama Seaside Studios has been welcoming travelers from around the world to experience the magic of Mastichari and Kos Island. What began as a family dream has blossomed into a beloved beachfront retreat, rated 8.9 out of 10 by over 200 guests. Our small complex of just 9 units means personal attention and a peaceful atmosphere.
about.philosophy: We believe that a great holiday starts with feeling truly at home. Our family-run approach means you'll always find a warm smile and a helpful hand. From the taverna serving fresh Greek dishes to the sun loungers on the sand, everything is designed for relaxation and enjoyment.
about.kosDesc: The island of Kos is a gem of the Dodecanese, blessed with golden beaches, ancient ruins, and vibrant local culture. Mastichari sits on the western coast, a charming fishing village with a pretty harbour, excellent restaurants, and a ferry connection to the island of Kalymnos.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything You Need to Know
faq.q1: How far is Panorama Seaside Studios from the beach?
faq.a1: We are literally steps from the beach! Panorama Seaside Studios sits right on the seafront in Mastichari, Kos. You can walk to the golden sandy beach in under a minute.
faq.q2: What are the check-in and check-out times?
faq.a2: Check-in is from 14:00 until midnight, and check-out is by 12:00. If you will arrive after reception hours, tell us in advance. Pets are not allowed, and the minimum check-in age is 18.
faq.q3: Is there free parking at the hotel?
faq.a3: Yes, we offer free private parking for all guests. There is ample space right next to our studios in Mastichari.
faq.q4: How do I get from Kos Airport to Mastichari?
faq.a4: Kos Airport (KGS) is approximately 20 km from Mastichari. You can reach us by taxi (about 25 minutes), rental car, or public bus. We can help arrange airport transfers upon request.
faq.q5: Do the rooms have a kitchen or kitchenette?
faq.a5: The two studios have a kitchenette with a fridge, kettle, coffee maker, and kitchenware. The double and twin rooms have a fridge, kettle, and coffee maker, and no kitchenette.
faq.q6: Is there a restaurant on site?
faq.a6: Yes! Our beachfront restaurant and bar serves fresh Greek dishes, snacks, and drinks throughout the day. Enjoy your meal with stunning sea views right on Mastichari Beach.
faq.q7: What is there to do in Mastichari, Kos?
faq.a7: Mastichari is a charming fishing village with golden sandy beaches, waterfront tavernas, and a harbour with daily ferries to Kalymnos. Kos Island offers ancient ruins, cycling paths, Kos Town nightlife, and beautiful beaches like Paradise and Tigaki.
faq.a8: Absolutely! We are a family-run hotel and welcome families with children. We have a playground on site, spacious rooms, and the shallow sandy beach in Mastichari is perfect for kids.
faq.q9: Do you have rooms with sea view?
faq.a9: Yes. The Seafront Luxury Studio, the Deluxe Double Room, and the Superior Twin Room with Sea View look over the Aegean from a private balcony.
faq.a10: Free cancellation is available up to 7 days before arrival. Cancellations within 7 days may be subject to a charge. Please contact us for specific details regarding your booking.
